scope: Synthetic local Chromium browser acceptance; no live Telegram/device integration

checks.name: Native profile submit saves without query-string navigation; dialog focuses its heading
Explicit next-week acceptance persists across reload
Profile changes preserve current and accepted snapshots; explicit cancel exposes the new proposal
Stale plan confirmation is rejected and requires reviewing the current proposal
Journal supports editing and confirmed deletion of individual facts
CSV preview, explicit plan linking and repeated-file idempotency work through the UI
Conflicting import is atomic; TCX import and independent activity deletion work
Reminder preferences persist and produce a real ICS with local-time conversion and alarm
Assistant explains personal data, all four presets work, and unsupported questions are scoped
Backup restores into a different identity; historical snapshots can be viewed and backfilled
All new screens fit 320, 390, 768 and 1440px with real content
Visibility/focus refresh preserves an open diary form
No uncaught JavaScript errors in the full-product flow
